name: heavy lids.mp4
speech: Her monolids had very thick, heavy eyelid folds.
I softened the lashes carefully on a flat rod first.
Using our soon-to-launch, lifted lounge step one perm solution.
Then I chose Edd Shields size one, the biggest size,
and noticed how I intentionally filled less than half of the shield.
I also did additional softening for a cleaner curl.
And look at this result, the lashes don't touch the eyelid at all,
even with thick lids, still beautifully lifted.
With thick monolids, thin or small shields will almost always touch the eyelid.
That's why Edd Shields size one works so beautifully.
